reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep Sea Creatures
reading.passage: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions. In deep ocean environments where sunlight cannot penetrate, many creatures use bioluminescence for communication, hunting, and defense. The anglerfish, for example, uses a glowing lure to attract prey in complete darkness. Scientists estimate that nearly 90% of deep-sea creatures possess some form of bioluminescence, making it one of nature's most remarkable adaptations to extreme environments.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary function of bioluminescence in deep-sea creatures?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'bioluminescence for communication, hunting, and defense'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Why can bioluminescence be considered an adaptation?
options: It is found in all ocean creatures
It helps creatures survive in lightless deep-sea environments
It makes creatures more visible to predators
It reduces the need for food
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '깊은 바다의 극한 환경에서의 적응'이라고 설명하고 있으며, 햇빛이 도달하지 않는 환경에서 생존하기 위한 진화적 특성입니다.

questions.q: What does the anglerfish example illustrate?
options: Bioluminescence is used for hunting prey
Fish cannot see in the ocean
questions.explanation: 앵글러피시의 예시는 생물발광을 이용해 먹이를 유인하는 사냥 방법을 보여줍니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has improved human relationships'? Use specific examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시 - technology가 human relationships를 개선했는지 아닌지 입장 표명 (2-3문장)
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장 개발 - 기술의 긍정적 영향 또는 부정적 영향을 구체적 예시와 함께 설명 (4-5문장)
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장 개발 - 다른 관점의 예시 제시하여 주장 강화 (4-5문장)
structure.conclusion: 입장 재확인 및 전체 논의 요약 (2-3문장)

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology has significantly improved...
For example, social media platforms allow...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer learning through hands-on experience. Others prefer learning through lectures and reading. Which approach do you prefer? Use specific reasons and examples to support your response.
useful_expressions: I prefer learning through hands-on experience because...
One reason is that practical experience helps me retain information better
Another advantage is that I can immediately apply what I learn
In my opinion, combining both methods is ideal
For instance, in science classes, lab work reinforces lecture concepts
sample_points: 실습을 통한 학습은 개념을 더 깊이 이해하고 오래 기억하게 함 - 예를 들어 화학 실험을 직접 수행하면 이론을 더 잘 이해하게 됨
자신의 속도에 맞춰 학습할 수 있고 즉각적인 피드백을 받을 수 있음 - 예를 들어 악기 연습이나 프로그래밍 코딩은 직접 해봐야 실력이 늘어남

listening.title: University Library Study Space Discussion
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I'm looking for a quiet study space in the library. Can you recommend a good spot? Librarian: Sure! I'd suggest the fourth floor. It's specifically designated for silent study. Most students don't know about it, so it's usually very quiet. The second floor has group study rooms if you need to work with classmates. We also recently renovated the third floor with individual study carrels. Each carrel has its own desk, lamp, and power outlet. Student: That sounds perfect! How do I reserve a carrel? Librarian: You don't need to reserve them. It's first-come, first-served. They're typically available after 3 PM on weekdays. Student: Great! One more question - what are the library hours? Librarian: We're open from 7 AM to 11 PM on weekdays and 9 AM to 8 PM on weekends.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To discuss the library's renovation plans
To provide information about study spaces in the library
To explain how to reserve group study rooms
questions.explanation: 학생이 조용한 공부 장소를 찾고 있고, 사서가 도서관의 여러 공부 공간에 대해 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, when are the individual study carrels typically available?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'typically available after 3 PM on weekdays'라고 명시하였습니다.

questions.q: Which floor is specifically designated for silent study?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'I'd suggest the fourth floor. It's specifically designated for silent study'라고 명확히 설명했습니다.
